decision: Geography: province = department_code (INDEC 2 digits, text with leading zero); department/partido/comuna = municipality_code (INDEC 5 digits). Every table carries department_code; province tables are the primary level (user request, 2026-11-18)
note: Same two-level shape as Mexico (state + municipality). Province tables were added where Mexico only has municipal ones: fact_population_department, fact_schools_department, fact_higher_ed_department, fact_companies_department.

decision: Geography keys and shapes from Georef (IGN) files of 2023-12-05: 24 jurisdictions and 529 departments; Georef centroids as reference points; geometries as published (already generalised), only converted to MultiPolygon with 5 decimals
note: No further simplification was applied (Mexico simplified INEGI's full-resolution shapes). CABA's 15 comunas are departments 02007-02105.

decision: Population = Censo 2022 resultados definitivos by province and department (year 2022)
note: INDEC publishes 2022-2040 projections only for the total country; no provincial or departmental projections from the 2022 census exist. 94021 Islas del Atlántico Sur has no census population (no row, never zero).

decision: Layer K: RA 2025 aggregated enrolment; target grades = años corridos 9-12; technical 13th-14th year excluded; schools = Padrón 2026 localizaciones with a common secondary offer
note: Años corridos make the target independent of the 6+6 / 7+5 provincial structures. Since 2024 the RA bases are published aggregated by department, so K5 median, size bands and K6 (cap 100 reach) cannot be computed: averages are given and K6 is empty. Department names of the RA were matched to Georef codes (98.1% of target students); masked rows ('Enmascarado') stay at province level only.

decision: Layers C and L: university figures from the SPU Anuario 2024 (national, institution, CPRES region, discipline Informática for ICT); provincial university students from Censo 2022 attendance (by residence); SNU enrolment from RA 2025; vocational training as centres counted in the Padrón
note: The SPU does not publish students by province or city of the programme. Census attendance is by residence and 2022; it is the only official provincial count. FP enrolment is not in the open data.

decision: Layers D, N, J: CEP XXI 'Distribución geográfica de los establecimientos productivos', 2022 rows. IT = CLAE6 620100, 620200, 620300, 620900, 631110, 631120, 631190, 631200; software = 620100; shops = 4711xx; businesses = distinct anonymised CUIT
note: Universe = establishments with registered employees (SIPA), private and majority state-owned companies; firms without employees are outside, unlike RUES (Colombia) or DENUE (Mexico). Three legacy department codes recoded to current ones: 06217->06218 (Chascomús), 94007->94008 (Río Grande), 94014->94015 (Ushuaia). Province business counts can add to more than the national distinct CUIT (firms present in several provinces).

decision: Layer J zones: CABA by its 15 comunas (CABA-) and the 24 partidos of Gran Buenos Aires defined by INDEC (GBA-)
note: User choice (2026-11-18). Each zone is a whole comuna or partido; micro = 1-9 registered employees, medium_large = 50+ (CEP XXI bands).

decision: EPH geography: each of the 31 agglomerates assigned to the province of its main city and anchored to the department of that city; Partidos del GBA anchored to La Matanza (06427), CABA to Comuna 1 (02007), San Nicolás-Villa Constitución to Buenos Aires, Viedma-Carmen de Patagones to Río Negro
note: The EPH covers urban agglomerates only (about 30 million people); provincial persona rows are the agglomerates of each province, not the whole province. EPH microdata do not identify the province inside bi-provincial agglomerates.

decision: Occupation mapping: a CNO-2001 5-digit code enters a persona when at least 50% of its weighted employed in INDEC's double-coded EPH 2015 Q1-Q2 hold a CIUO-08 code of that persona, with at least 5 interviews
note: INDEC's official correspondence is only at CIUO-08 2 digits. Result: P01, P03, P06, P07, P10, P11, P12, P13 identifiable; P02, P04, P05, P08, P09 have no majority code (empty, never zero). P01 also holds most database/network professionals (P01 codes: recall 87%, precision 91% for CIUO-08 251+252). Recall and precision per persona in outputs/f_persona_correspondence_ar.csv; code-by-code cross-reference (which CNO-2001 codes each persona holds, where the workers of the empty personas sit, and 2025 employment per code) in outputs/f_persona_crossref_ar.csv. No manual overrides applied (f_mapping_overrides.csv is empty).

decision: Layer M: micro-businesses = own-account workers and employers in units of up to 10 people (EPH 2025)
note: Argentina has no micro-business survey (EMICRON equivalent). EPH size bands are 1-5 and 6-10, so the template limit of 9 cannot be applied (as in Mexico). M4 digital adoption is not available.

decision: Period: EPH 2025 Q1-Q4 (calendar year, as Mexico), although 2026 Q1-Q2 results are already published (informe de septiembre de 2026); RA 2025; Anuario universitario 2024; CEP XXI 2022 (latest open release); Censo 2022
note: Latest complete sources at 2026-11-18. Periods differ by layer and are written on every table and row.

decision: Layer A and B engines re-implemented from the Mexico/Peru outputs (scripts/build-argentina-a-github.py, build-argentina-b-survey.py) and validated by reproducing every Mexico row before running for Argentina
note: The Peru engines (layer_a_country.py, layer_b_engine.py) were not in the delivered package.

decision: Socioeconomic level = household per-capita income deciles 7-10 of the total EPH (DECCFR); size bands 201+ and 11-200 (EPH bands cut at 10 and 200, as Colombia)
note: Replaces Colombia's electricity stratum and Mexico's ENOE stratum. Income = P21 weighted with PONDIIO, current pesos of each quarter (2025 had high inflation: medians mix quarters).

decision: Price layer: Com. A 3500 2025 average and December 2025 average; minimum wage = 2025 average of the 12 monthly SMVM amounts and the December 2025 amount
note: Both annual and December values are shown because the peso moved strongly during 2025.

decision: Web map display: polygon parts lying entirely south of 60°S (the Antarctic sector of Tierra del Fuego, department 94028 Antártida Argentina) are left out of the map; the country is framed on its continental extent
note: Web Mercator cannot draw the sector down to the South Pole, and no data refer to it (no census population, no establishments). geo_department_shape and geo_municipality_shape keep the geometry exactly as published by Georef; only lib/argentinaData.js filters it. Islas del Atlántico Sur (94021) stay on the map.

decision: Load Argentina in the application through a read-only file adapter (lib/argentinaData.js, /api/argentina/*), as Mexico (D-MX-01) and Peru; province values come from the province tables, never from summing departments
note: Some province figures cannot be rebuilt from departments: RA rows masked by statistical secrecy, distinct firms (CUIT) counted once per province, and EPH figures that exist only by province. Checks: node scripts/check-argentina.js.
